item.title: [idea] Evaluate using gRCP to replace current management end points in REST APIs
item.author: emecas
item.description:
[idea] Evaluate using gRCP to replace current management end points in REST APIs
For actions like:

- controlling logging level
- expiring caches
- refreshing security tokens
- checking health and status
- triggering process
- debugging

See recommendation for a container approach about exposing host port and network configuration here: https://stackoverflow.com/a/44642449/833336

Issue #35 in emecas/commitit, open, opened on 2020-03-21.
https://github.com/emecas/commitit/issues/35

Source: issue #35 in emecas/commitit, opened on 2020-03-21.
